blocks.content: You might be thinking: "Can't I just use regular JavaScript?"
You can, but Modern JavaScript makes your code:

items: Easier to read - Clear, expressive syntax that communicates intent
Less buggy - Features like const and optional chaining prevent common mistakes
More maintainable - Better organization with classes and clear structure
Industry standard - What professional teams expect in 2026

blocks.content: When you apply for developer positions or collaborate on projects, Modern JavaScript is the baseline. It's not advanced - it's foundational.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
